title: Turn a square of paper into a swan, with folds alone
alt: A white paper crane with pointed wings against a blue background.

posts.facebook:
Origami needs nothing but paper. The British Origami Society and OrigamiUSA both publish free diagrams, and local groups and library classes meet in the UK and the US. Fold a few simple models first, then look for a beginners' class.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-origami/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do

Photo: Andreas Bauer Origami-Kunst, CC BY-SA 2.5 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5), via Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Origami-crane.jpg (cropped).
